verses.text: From Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ. To God's chosen people, who live as foreigners scattered through Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia and Bithynia.

God the Father knew you and chose you long ago. The Spirit has made you holy, so that you will obey Jesus Christ and be made clean by his blood. May God give you more and more of his kindness and peace.
Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! Because of his great mercy, he has given us new life. Jesus Christ rose from the dead, and so we have a living hope.
God has kept a gift for you in heaven that can never be destroyed, spoiled or fade away.
Through your faith, God's power protects you until the salvation that is ready to be shown at the end of time.
This makes you very glad, even though for a little while you may have to suffer many kinds of troubles.

These troubles test your faith, which is worth more than gold. Gold can be tested by fire, but it will not last. Your faith, proved true, will bring praise, glory and honour when Jesus Christ appears.
You have never seen him, yet you love him. You do not see him now, but you believe in him, and you are filled with a great joy, too glorious for words.
For you are receiving what your faith is aiming for: the salvation of your souls.
The prophets searched and studied very carefully about this salvation. They spoke about the kindness God would show to you.
The Spirit of Christ in them told them ahead of time about Christ's sufferings and the glory that would come after. They tried to find out who this would be, and when it would happen.

God showed them that their work was not for themselves, but for you. Now these things have been told to you by those who preached the good news with the help of the Holy Spirit sent from heaven. Even the angels long to look into these things.
So get your minds ready for action. Keep a clear head, and put all your hope in the kindness God will give you when Jesus Christ appears.
Be obedient children of God. Do not live by the wrong desires you followed when you did not know better.
Instead, be holy in everything you do, just as God who called you is holy.
For the Scriptures say, "Be holy, because I am holy."
You call God your Father, and he judges everyone fairly by what they have done. So live with deep respect for him while you are foreigners here on earth.
You know that God paid to set you free from the empty way of life you learned from your ancestors. He did not pay with silver or gold, which do not last.
He paid with the precious blood of Christ, who was like a perfect lamb without any fault.
God chose Christ before the world was made, but he has come in these last days for your sake.
Through Christ you believe in God, who raised him from death and gave him glory. So your faith and hope are in God.
You have made yourselves pure by obeying the truth, so now you truly love each other as brothers and sisters. So keep on loving each other deeply, with all your heart.
You have been given new life, not from a seed that dies, but from one that cannot die. You have been born again through God's word, which is alive and lasts forever.
As the Scripture says, "All people are like grass, and all their glory is like the flowers in the field. The grass dries up and the flower falls,
but the word of the Lord lasts forever." And this word is the good news that was preached to you.
